Proposition
[Simply-connected iff unique homotopy class of connecting paths]

↗ def:simply-connected ↗ def:homotopy-of-paths

1. ch1:1.6\group Fundamental Group

A space $X$ is simply-connected iff every two points of $X$ are joined by a unique homotopy class of paths.

Proof

\sketch If $\pi _1(X)=0$ and $f,g$ join $x_0$ to $x_1$, then $f\simeq f\cdot \bar g\cdot g\simeq g$. Conversely, uniqueness for paths from $x_0$ to itself identifies every loop with the constant loop, while existence of paths gives path-connectedness.

□
